steps.title: Begin with acquired source evidence
steps.explanation: Inspect the ten original atlas surfaces with their units and per-part provenance. A research extension starts from this reference data and records every geometric transformation; the source surfaces alone do not supply an executable musculoskeletal model.
steps.observe: All ten source structures are visible. No subject matching or clinical validation is reported.

steps.title: Add a mechanical reference carefully
steps.explanation: The apparatus uses derived reference files and an authored hinge construction. Inspect its bone layer while retaining the separate historical trajectory status. A reference frame and a mechanically accepted time step are different deliverables.
steps.observe: Three apparatus reference bones appear. The selected historical run is still rejected and has no accepted snapshots.

steps.title: Locate the remaining acceptance work
steps.explanation: Now inspect the original derived tissue volumes. Later chapters document reference repairs, reduced solves and denser trajectory receipts; none makes these original bellies a calibrated biological response. Continued work must resolve local compression, integration sensitivity and missing nodal stationarity.
steps.observe: Seven derived reference bellies appear. Historical residual and gate remain visible. The scene makes no patient-specific, force-velocity or whole-tissue convergence claim.

audit.finding: The research-stage switch implied a single progression while loading different original reference and historical-result files without their acceptance boundaries.
audit.change: The sequence separates acquired atlas, apparatus bones and derived tissue; it keeps historical result status beside the geometry.
audit.remaining: Connected variable-area specimen, measured architecture/physiology, anatomical calibration and qualified tissue-envelope convergence remain research gaps.
